'''Ulendale''' was a destination on the [[Hovertrain/Legends|Coruscant train]].

==Behind the scenes==
An [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] list of stops that pops up at the [[Hovertrain/Legends|hover train]] station has Ulendale listed, along with [[Burbank/Legends|Burbank]], [[Arabia/Legends|Arabia]] and [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. For reasons unknown, the same data screens were also found in [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].
